final_message:
I fixed `slugify` in `slug.mjs`. `slugify("  Hello -- World! ")` now returns `"hello-world"`, and both existing tests pass with `node --test`.

The old code replaced each non-alphanumeric character with its own dash. I changed the first replacement to match a run of them (`/[^a-z0-9]+/g`), so a run becomes a single dash. I then added a second replacement that removes a dash at the start or end.

I didn't add a test for the bug report's input. I checked it by calling the function directly.
